_comment: Key mappings step 18 applies with macOS's own settings (macos/modifier-keys.py, macos/capslock-to-f18.zsh). Caps Lock sends F18 on every keyboard, and shortcut 160 (symbolic-hotkeys.plist) makes F18 open Launchpad (Show Apps on macOS 27). keyboards: external keyboards by USB vendor and product id, each with its modifier swaps and the whole F1-F12 row as it should act (an external keyboard has no Fn layer). built_in_function_keys: only the top-row keys of the Mac's own keyboard that differ from Apple's default. Key and target names are those in modifier-keys.py's TARGET table.
